annotation.interpretation_a: The sender can retain its congestion window if *some* packets are paced above the initial congestion window, even if others aren't.
annotation.interpretation_b: The sender can only retain its congestion window if *all* packets are paced above the initial congestion window.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'any packets' is ambiguous. It could mean 'at least one' or 'all'. This difference in interpretation affects whether a sender can retain its congestion window by pacing a single packet above the initial congestion window, or if it must pace all packets.
annotation.missing_information: The meaning of 'any' is unclear. Does it mean 'at least one' or 'all'? This affects whether pacing a single packet allows retention of the congestion window.
